title: Missale Syriacum (Rome Propaganda, 1843) — Anaphora of St. James Core — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Bounded constituent of the six core prayers of the Anaphora of St. James (Preface, Sanctus, Post-Sanctus, Institution Narrative, Anamnesis, and Epiclesis) in Classical Syriac (syr), reading the right-hand Syriac column on bilingual Syriac/Garshuni pages (PDF 135, 136, 139, 140 L1) and full-width Syriac on monolingual pages (PDF 136 bottom, 138, 140), excluding the scan-degraded red-ink opening Dialogue line on PDF 135, the Crucifixion engraving plate at PDF 137, Garshuni columns, rubrics, and post-epiclesis diptychs.

pages.description: Front matter (titles PDF 9-10), Ordo Communis, Presanctified rite, and opening of St. James through Peace/Kiss.
Opening of Preface in Syriac right column (printed p. 104 / ܩܕ; scan-degraded red-ink Dialogue line above and left-column Garshuni excluded).
Preface continuation (right Syriac column), single-word Sanctus incipit, and full-width Post-Sanctus (printed p. 105 / ܩܗ).
Full-page Crucifixion engraving plate preceding Institution Narrative (printed p. 106 unnumbered).
Full-width Syriac Institution Narrative of Bread and Chalice (printed p. 107).
Anamnesis in right-hand Syriac column (printed p. 108; parallel Garshuni left column excluded).
Final phrase of Anamnesis (L1 right Syriac column) and full-width Epiclesis (printed p. 109; post-epiclesis diptychs below excluded).
Diptychs, fraction, communion, remaining six anaphoras, Patriarch Giarve 1840 attestation and imprimaturs (PDF 272), and back matter.
